report_name: ATF Confirms Major Incident After Qilin Ransomware Breach Claim

threat_actors.name: Qilin
threat_actors.description: A Russian-linked Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) group that claimed responsibility for a major cybersecurity incident at the U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) by listing the agency on its dark web leak site on August 26, 2026.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through double-extortion ransomware attacks.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin ransomware group employs double-extortion tactics, which includes encrypting victim data to pressure them into paying a ransom.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: Qilin ransomware operators are known to delete volume shadow copies and stop backup-related services, such as Veeam, to hamper recovery efforts.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: As part of its double-extortion model, the Qilin group exfiltrates sensitive data before encryption and threatens to publish it on their leak site.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Access Software
attack_patterns.description: The Qilin group is known to abuse legitimate remote access tools like AnyDesk and Splashtop for persistence and control within a compromised network.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: Qilin operators use PowerShell scripts, such as vss.ps1, to delete volume shadow copies as part of their defense evasion and recovery inhibition tactics.

malware.name: Qilin Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware payload used by the Qilin group to encrypt victim systems. In this incident, it was used against a standalone system at the ATF.

tools.name: AnyDesk
tools.description: A legitimate remote access tool known to be abused by Qilin operators for persistence and control.

tools.name: Splashtop
tools.description: A legitimate remote access tool known to be abused by Qilin operators for persistence and control.

identities.name: U.S. Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives
identities.description: A U.S. federal law enforcement agency that confirmed a 'major' cybersecurity incident after being listed on the Qilin ransomware leak site. The breach was contained to a standalone system holding information on criminal investigation targets.

identities.name: Department of Justice
identities.description: The U.S. federal department that the ATF is a component of. Senior DOJ officials designated the breach at the ATF as a 'major incident'.

infrastructure.name: Qilin Leak Site
infrastructure.description: The dark web data leak site used by the Qilin ransomware group to publish victim names and exfiltrated data as part of their double-extortion strategy.

indicators.name: Qilin Backup Service Termination
indicators.pattern:
title: Qilin Ransomware Backup Service Termination
id: 2b8c1f9a-e5d4-4f8a-a1b2-c3d4e5f6a7b8
status: experimental
description: Detects command line activity used by Qilin ransomware to stop backup-related services, such as Veeam, before encryption.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/atf-confirms-major-incident-after-recent-qilin-breach-claims/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\net.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'stop'
      - 'Veeam'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects commands used by Qilin to stop backup services like Veeam, a precursor to encryption.

indicators.name: Qilin VSS Deletion Script Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Qilin VSS Deletion PowerShell Script
id: 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-2c1d-0e9f8a7b6c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of a PowerShell script named 'vss.ps1', which is known to be used by Qilin ransomware to delete volume shadow copies.
references:
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/atf-confirms-major-incident-after-recent-qilin-breach-claims/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\vss.ps1'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the presence of 'vss.ps1', a script used by Qilin to delete volume shadow copies.

indicators.name: Qilin Remote Access Tool Execution

id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a9b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d

description: Detects the execution of legitimate remote access tools like AnyDesk or Splashtop, which are known to be abused by Qilin operators for persistence and control.
references:

author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-27
tags:
  - attack.t1219
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\AnyDesk.exe'
      - '\Splashtop.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of remote access tools like AnyDesk and Splashtop, which are abused by Qilin for control.
